LanguageData.ApparelPainter_SwatchTip: Change color. The stand previews your choice as you pick; Cancel restores what was there.
LanguageData.ApparelPainter_DirectInputTip: Type a color and press Enter: hex (EFD8AE or #EFD8AE) or a decimal triplet (237,216,174 — bytes, or 0-1 floats). No alpha. When not editing, this shows the current color's hex, ready to copy to another stand.
LanguageData.ApparelPainter_DropperTip: Pick up this item's color into the open color picker.
LanguageData.ApparelPainter_OldColorTip: Pick the old color back up — the color this picker opened with.
LanguageData.ApparelPainter_SaveSwatchTip: Save the current color as a swatch. Saved swatches persist across games.
LanguageData.ApparelPainter_SavedSwatchTip: {0}. Click to use, right-click to remove.
LanguageData.ApparelPainter_MapDropperTip: Sample a color from the map: click anything — furniture, items, pawns, corpses, floors. A cell with several sources lists the whole stack, floor included; bare floor samples instantly. Keeps sampling until you right-click or press Escape; click this button again to stop.
LanguageData.ApparelPainter_BrightnessTip: Brightness. The wheel picks hue and saturation; this slider is the third axis.
